lua: T = require('lib.testkit'); S = require('lib.state'); CAM = require('lib.camera'); FOLLOW = nil; LOOK = function(lx, ly, lz, ty, fov) local v = nova.named('van'); local s, c = math.sin(v.heading), math.cos(v.heading); local g = nova.terrain_height(v.x, v.z); CAM.pinned = { v.x + s * lz + c * lx, g + ly, v.z + c * lz - s * lx, v.x, g + (ty or 0.9), v.z, fov or 40 } end; SEAT = function(lx, ly, lz, fov) local v = nova.named('van'); local s, c = math.sin(v.heading), math.cos(v.heading); local g = nova.terrain_height(v.x, v.z); local tx, ty, tz = v:to_world(0.3, 1.0, 0.35); CAM.pinned = { v.x + s * lz + c * lx, g + ly, v.z + c * lz - s * lx, tx, g + ty, tz, fov or 30 } end; PARK = function(x, z, h) local v = nova.named('van'); v.autopilot = nil; v.driven = false; v.engine_on = false; v:teleport(x, z, h); nova.scene_now().mode = 'foot'; nova.named('postmaster').seated = false end; SIT = function() local s = nova.scene_now(); s.mode = 'van'; local v = nova.named('van'); v.driven = true; v.engine_on = true; nova.named('postmaster').seated = true end; STAND = function(where, turn) local s = nova.scene_now(); local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z = s:van_point(where); p.face = nova.named('van').heading + turn; CAM.pinned = nil; CAM.reset(p.face) end
